title: Elizabeth White House Grayt 30A Vacations
description_expanded: AboutElizabeth White House ~ 30 Thyme Street ~ Seagrove Beach FL 32459 Need a last-minute stay? Please call our office at 844-941-1213 to make last-minute bookings via telephone, as availability within the next 7-nights will not show on calendar. We do not allow online bookings within 7-nights/one week of an arrival date. 30% Discount off Spring Rates! 4-night minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to May 22nd. Discount is reflected in online pricing. 20% Discount off Summer 2026! 4-nt minimum with flexible arrival/departure days. Valid on new bookings only for stays completed prior to August 8th! Discount is reflected in online pricing. The Elizabeth White House is the perfect family vacation home, with 2,8972sf of indoor living, 1,600sq of expansive Gulf view balconies, 50' from 30A with Thyme Street beach access directly across, and a 3-minute walk into Seaside. With 4 bedrooms/4 full baths/1 half bath, the Elizabeth White House will sleep up to 10 guests and offers 2 living areas, recently renovated bathrooms and kitchen, a private, 12' x 24' heated pool (heating fee applies) and lots of spread-out room. On-street parking is not allowed; please note parking spaces below and plan accordingly. Ground Level: 1 bedroom. 1 bath. Laundry room. Carport. #1 En-suite bedroom has a King bed, walk-in shower Second Level: Family room, kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, covered balcony with Gulf views. #2 Bedroom has a Queen bed #3 Bedroom has 2 Bunks (4T) 2 Full Baths, one with walk-in shower, the other with tub/shower and double vanity Third Level: Main living room, dining table for 8, bar seating for 4, fully equipped kitchen, powder room, 1 bedroom, 1 bath, covered balcony with Gulf views and additional dining for 8. #4 En-Suite (Master) Bedroom has a King bed, sitting room, walk-in shower, separate vanities, water closet, balcony access Fourth Level: East and West observation decks with expansive views of the Gulf and the rooftops of Seaside.Amenities: Business Features Wireless Internet (password secured) Entertainment Features 5 Flat Screen TVs, 2 Blu-Ray/DVD players, whole house stereo, board games, puzzles, books, movies Distinctive Features Expansive Gulf views Private heated pool (heating fee applies) 2 living rooms Bed, bath, kitchen linens provided Beach Gear Credit General Features Carport parking for 2 cars, driveway parking for 2 vehicles (on-street parking is not allowed, so please plan accordingly) 2 King beds, 1 Queen bed, 2 Bunks (4 Twins) 4 full bathrooms, 1 powder room, iron, ironing board, 4 hair dryers, wet bar, separate ice maker, outdoor gas grill w/ grill utensils, outdoor shower and foot wash, outdoor balconies with Gulf views, balcony furniture. Out door security cameras (at pool equipment, carport). Linens provided. No Smoking. No Pets. *PLEASE NOTE - It is not recommended to heat the pool in colder weather, as heaters will not be able to heat to the desired setting as ambient temperatures fall below 50 degrees. Kitchen Features Fully equipped kitchen, coffee maker, Keurig, gas range, refrigerator with ice dispenser, 2 microwaves, dishwasher, toaster, blender, 2 washers, 2 dryers, kitchenette, separate ice maker, 2 beverage fridges. Area Features Timpoochee Trail (30A bike path) Seaside (7/10th mile) State Parks (Tops’l, Grayton Beach, Deer Lake)
